entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this helmet I bought. And let's not make this difficult, I'm already in a bad mood.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The issue is the color is hideous! It looks nothing like it did online. I'm not putting that on my head. I haven't even opened it, the box is unopened, still sealed.
I understand, that can definitely be frustrating when the color isn't what you expected. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF9987-5. Look, are you going to take it back or not? If you give me any trouble I swear I'll just talk to your manager. I will light up your reviews page.
No need for that, I'm happy to resolve this for you. Let me just pull up that order... Okay, I see it. The VeloFit Aura helmet, delivered eight days ago. I'm just confirming the policy for you now.
There's nothing to confirm! Just take it back! How hard can this be?

You're absolutely right. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can approve this return immediately. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied and that your safety gear is a perfect fit for you.
Oh. So... you're just going to approve it? No fees or anything?

That's correct. Since the box is unopened, you'll get a full refund. I've just emailed a prepaid return shipping label to the address on file. Just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed.
Wow. Okay. That was... actually really easy. Thanks.
You're very welcome. We appreciate your business. Was there anything else I could assist with today?
No, that's it. Thank you, Charlie.
You too. Have a great day, and ride safe.
